titulo_da: Læsning 2 · Fortæller og perspektiv i prosa
titulo_es: A limited perspective · Narrator and prose perspective

texto: In prose, it separates who narrates who perceives. A scene can omit explanations and let the reader infer a motive from gestures, references and time changes.

frases.da: Han så lyset i vinduet, men hørte ingen stemmer.
frases.es: Vio la luz en la ventana, pero no oyó voces.
frases.en: He saw the light in the window, but he didn't hear voices.

frases.da: Derfor gættede han på, at huset var tomt.
frases.es: Por eso supuso que la casa estaba vacía.
frases.en: That's why he assumed the house was empty.
